issue: #27 (the wasm wall is red: TS/Bun case tables vs Go case tables)
corpusDomain: Every Unicode scalar 0..0x10FFFF excluding the surrogate range, retained only where String.prototype.toUpperCase changes the scalar under the recording engine (1552 entries), each submitted as the payload "a=<scalar>" through compose(renameStream("z"), filterKeyPrefix("a"), mapValueUpper()). Malformed-UTF-8 and non-key-value entries from the wall test are NOT in this corpus: they carry no case mapping and so cannot attribute a case-table divergence. Nothing outside this domain is claimed.
cause: packages/core/src/xform.ts mapValueUpper delegates to the JS engine's String.prototype.toUpperCase (Bun/JSC ICU, Unicode 16+); go/stream uses Go's stdlib unicode tables (Unicode 15.0.0). These 27 scalars gained an uppercase mapping in Unicode 16. Both sides KEEP the same events; only case-mapped content differs. Neither table is pinned anywhere, which is the finding.
expectedDisposition: NEXT.md's owed fix — pin MapValueUpper to ASCII-only on BOTH sides plus non-ASCII law tests — removes the external-table dependency from the digest path entirely. When that lands, this fixture and its gate are DELETED, not re-frozen: an allowlist that outlives its defect is a licence.
